name: plugin-notion-mcp
stderr:
Usage: plugin-mcp [options] [command]

Official Notion MCP installer.

Options:
  -V, --version       output the version number
  -h, --help          display help for command

Commands:
  install <server>    Install an MCP server
  doctor [options]    Inspect your Notion MCP environment
  list                List supported Notion MCP servers
  login <server>      Store Notion credentials securely
  logout <server>     Remove stored Notion credentials
  verify              Verify your Notion MCP installation
  uninstall <server>  Remove the Notion MCP server
  help [command]      display help for command
